title: Releases and service health
summary: A deployment's rollouts as events in time, the service signals they may change (latency, errors, restarts), what else changes at the same time (traffic, other services), and the evidence a rollout leaves (pods, events, logs).

concepts.label: Rollout
concepts.description: A new revision of a Kubernetes Deployment: a ReplicaSet with a new pod template, or an old one made current again (a rollback).

facts.text: A Deployment keeps old ReplicaSets (revisionHistoryLimit, 10 by default); each carries the annotation deployment.kubernetes.io/revision, and a rollback renumbers the reused one (revision-history keeps its old numbers).

children.label: Image
children.description: The container image (repository and tag) of the pod template.

children.label: ReplicaSet
children.description: The pods of one pod template; its pod-template-hash names its pods.

children.label: Pod
children.description: A running instance; replaced revisions' pods are gone, their logs remain.

children.label: Kubernetes event
children.description: Scaling, scheduling, probe failures, back-offs; kept an hour by default (--event-ttl).

concepts.label: Service level indicator
concepts.description: A measure of how the service behaves for its users.

facts.text: histogram_quantile computes a quantile from a histogram's buckets by linear interpolation within the bucket that holds it.

children.label: p99 latency
children.description: The 99th percentile of request duration, ms.

children.label: Container restarts
children.description: Restarts per step (kube-state-metrics), e.g. OOM kills.

concepts.label: Confounder
concepts.description: What changes at the same time as a rollout and moves the same signals.

children.label: Traffic
children.description: Requests per second; latency grows with load.

children.label: Neighbour service
children.description: Other services of the namespace: if they moved too, the cause is likely shared.

children.label: Dependency incident
children.description: A database, cache or upstream service degrading on its own.

concepts.label: Before/after comparison
concepts.description: The difference of medians of two windows, its block-bootstrap interval, and the Mann-Whitney U test.

children.label: Canary comparison
children.description: Both versions at the same time under the same load: the stronger design.
